topic: Challenge video: friends earn $100 for every football trick-shot goal at a stadium (Top Eleven sponsor)
hero: Luke Nuttall and Ben Nuttall (on-screen name tags) with a third man in Red Bull shirt
hook: Man in yellow kicks ball near stadium stand, then voice-over states the $100-per-trickshot rule
subtitle_style: bold lime-green and red kinetic labels (e.g. LAMBORGHINI, SPIDER MAN, YOGA, 180°) near the ball line; green '$100' pop-up money text; italic 'COMING UP' tag; $ counter pill bottom-left
reaction_overlays: name tags Luke/Ben with avatar chips, $ counter pill with avatar, picture-in-picture reaction cam top-right, B&W teaser flash, thumbnail grid card, floating $100 icons
transition_summary: Fast hard cuts with whip/flash teasers; very frequent (~4-5 cuts/10s, 27 detected cuts in 63s); b&w 'coming up' teaser, slow-mo
audio_note: Casual YouTuber voice-over/dialogue ('For every trick shot goal my friends score they get $100'), upbeat music, game sponsor read

reuse_segments.what: Own-shot trick-shot challenge with kinetic labels and $ counter
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: Own-production format; recreate the label/counter graphics and trick-shot ball-line staging with own cast (sponsor link needs clearing)
